claim: The U.S. Department of Justice's Epstein file production contains a run of staff emails about "jerky," read online as a code for human meat. The documents: An October 3, 2012 email from Francis Derby — identified in a separate 2012 staff email as Epstein's chef ("Francis Derby is Jeffrey's chef now") — reads, "Just wanted to touch base about Jerky. JE [Jeffrey Epstein] said he was gonna start eating regular food again so he might be eating less jerky. That said he has 6 bags of it in the downstairs freezer for his next trip." A September 2013 instruction email from Epstein associate Karyna Shuliak lists "sealed foods and beef jerky for JE," all of which "should go to the freezer." A personal-chef meal-prep list catalogs jerky to "store in freezer and pull out as you need it" alongside muffins, a ginger drink, and steak, with marinade "for jerky emergency" sufficient for "about 10 NY strips" (New York strip steaks). The specific figures attached to the viral reading have no match in the production: no "68 pounds of jerky" (the meal-prep number is "about 10 NY strips"), no instruction to "send it to the lab," no order for 330 gallons of sulfuric acid ("sulfuric acid" appears only in water-treatment, rail-freight, and news-clipping contexts, including the reverse-osmosis system that served the New Mexico ranch), and no document tying Derby to a restaurant named "Cannibal."

notes: Read verbatim from the full local corpus (work/corpus.jsonl, 1.05M docs). The 'jerky' hits across DS9/DS10 are food logistics from Epstein's kitchen/assistant staff; the specific viral figures do not appear: no '68 pounds of jerky' (the real meal-prep number is 5 lbs / 'about 10 NY strips'), no 'send it to the lab,' no Epstein-Gates 'jerky' exchange. 'intestines' appears only in a reflexology/anatomy book in the production (Data Set 4), not in any email. The '330 gallons of sulfuric acid' figure has no primary trace: '330 gallon' hits are aviation-fuel pricing logs (Azores/Malta/West Palm Beach legs); 'sulfuric acid' hits are rail-freight carload categories, a water-treatment feed pump, a Solvay corporate sale, and a Gaza-flotilla news clipping. Francis Derby is a real, documented Epstein chef (multiple 2012 logistics emails); the 'owns the restaurant Cannibal' link has no document behind it (a real NYC butcher-bar named The Cannibal exists, but nothing in the release ties Derby to it). url:null pending publication of these DS docs to the /efta/ doc viewer. The surfacing reel's cannibalism framing is not adopted — the claim states only what the documents record. Pairs with the Zorro burial-tips record.
